scope: Library header only: default, category filtering, actor and series tabs. Existing accepted cards and detail screens preserved.
method: Product Design audit: current screenshot evidence, information hierarchy, control consistency, keyboard and responsive checks.

sources.title: Carbon Tabs
sources.applied: Line tabs distinguish films, people and series; remove contained tab backgrounds.

sources.title: Carbon Content Switcher
sources.applied: The view switch is lower in hierarchy and changes the presentation of the same items.

sources.title: Carbon Data Table Toolbar
sources.applied: Keep utilities together and use consistent sizes; applied by analogy to a media grid, not a table clone.

sources.title: Material Filter Chips
sources.applied: Category choices use a compact selected chip distinct from content navigation.

steps.name: Default library
steps.before: High visual weight: full glass panel, nested selected surfaces and underlines, four competing control treatments.
steps.after: Clearer: quiet title, line tabs, grouped utilities, separate category chips and one result count.

steps.name: Category filtering
steps.before: Selected category resembles a second navigation tab; mobile header occupies 218px.
steps.after: Distinct chip selection, result count updates. Mobile header is 159px at 390px viewport width. A selected category remains visible in its scroll container.

steps.name: Actor directory
steps.before: Repeats the same heavy tab and filter surfaces.
steps.after: Same header rhythm with actor-specific filtering and sorting; compact actor cards preserved.

steps.name: Series directory
steps.before: Same oversized header surface as the film view.
steps.after: Same hierarchy and result count, series-specific sorting; member cover compositions preserved.

limits: Sample prototype only; no real media playback or server state.
No screen reader certification or full accessibility audit.
